targetTexts.1: A man who remains stiff-necked after much reproof will suddenly be shattered beyond recovery.
targetTexts.2: When the righteous flourish, the people rejoice, but when the wicked rule, the people groan.
targetTexts.3: A man who loves wisdom brings joy to his father, but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.
targetTexts.4: By justice a king brings stability to the land, but a man who exacts tribute demolishes it.
targetTexts.5: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.
targetTexts.6: An evil man is caught by his own sin, but a righteous one sings and rejoices.
targetTexts.7: The righteous consider the cause of the poor, but the wicked have no regard for such concerns.
targetTexts.8: Mockers inflame a city, but the wise turn away anger.
targetTexts.9: If a wise man goes to court with a fool, there will be raving and laughing with no resolution.
targetTexts.10: Men of bloodshed hate a blameless man, but the upright care for his life.
targetTexts.11: A fool vents all his anger, but a wise man holds it back.
targetTexts.12: If a ruler listens to lies, all his officials will be wicked.
targetTexts.13: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: The LORD gives light to the eyes of both.
targetTexts.14: A king who judges the poor with fairness—his throne will be established forever.
targetTexts.15: A rod of correction imparts wisdom, but a child left to himself disgraces his mother.
targetTexts.16: When the wicked thrive, rebellion increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.
targetTexts.17: Discipline your son, and he will give you rest; he will bring delight to your soul.
targetTexts.18: Where there is no vision, the people cast off restraint; but blessed is he who keeps the Law.
targetTexts.19: A servant cannot be corrected by words alone; though he understands, he will not respond.
targetTexts.20: Do you see a man who speaks in haste? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
targetTexts.21: A servant pampered from his youth will bring grief in the end.
targetTexts.22: An angry man stirs up dissension, and a hot-tempered man abounds in transgression.
targetTexts.23: A man’s pride will bring him low, but a humble spirit will obtain honor.
targetTexts.24: A partner to a thief hates his own soul; he receives the oath but does not testify.
targetTexts.25: The fear of man is a snare, but whoever trusts in the LORD is set securely on high.
targetTexts.26: Many seek the ruler’s favor, but a man receives justice from the LORD.
targetTexts.27: An unjust man is detestable to the righteous, and one whose way is upright is detestable to the wicked.
